<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914115_theRebbe_704" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914115_theRebbe_704__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the service of turning from evil and doing good is perfected through Torah study, especially the inner dimensions of Torah, which connect the hidden essence of Israel with the hidden essence of the Holy One, and that the revelation of Atzmus is specifically in the inner Torah, particularly as revealed in Chassidus.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="1">that in order for the service of "turn from evil"</t>
    <t s="2">(the aspect of Nefesh)</t>
    <t s="3">and "do good"</t>
    <t s="4">(the aspect of Ruach)</t>
    <t s="5">to be as required,</t>
    <t s="6">it is through engaging in Torah study</t>
    <t s="7">(the aspect of Neshamah),</t>
    <t s="8">and particularly through engaging in the inner dimensions of Torah,</t>
    <t s="9">in the secrets of Torah and the secrets of secrets,</t>
    <t s="10">for the aspect of the inner dimension of Torah, called the hidden aspect of Torah, is that which connects and unites the aspect of the hidden of Israel with the aspect of the hidden of the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="11">And although the drawing down of the Atzmus [Essence] that is in the Torah is in all parts of Torah,</t>
    <t s="12">even in the revealed part of Torah,</t>
    <t s="13">and even in the reading of the letters of the Torah</t>
    <t s="14">(even when one does not know what is being said),</t>
    <t s="15">as explained in the Hemshech of Ta"aR"B [5662],</t>
    <t s="16">nevertheless, it is explained there that the revelation of Atzmus is specifically in the inner dimensions of Torah</t>
    <t s="17">[for the innerness of Abba is the innerness of Atik,</t>
    <t s="18">and therefore the revelation of the innerness of Atik is specifically in the innerness of Abba].</t>
    <t s="19">And particularly in the inner dimensions of Torah as they were revealed in the Torah of Chassidus by the Baal Shem Tov,</t>
    <t s="20">and all the more so as they were revealed by the Alter Rebbe in the Chassidus of Chabad,</t>
    <t s="21">in a manner of "they shall be sustained."</t>
    <t s="22">And through engaging in Torah,</t>
    <t s="23">and particularly in the inner dimensions of Torah,</t>
    <t s="24">there is also an elevation in the service of "turn from evil" and "do good."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the teshuvah of Shabbos Shuvah is not for simple sins but for the subtle sense of self, and similarly, the teshuvah regarding doing good and seeking peace involves enhancing mitzvah observance, Torah study, and spreading Chassidus, culminating in the ultimate redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, just as the teshuvah of "Return, O Israel, for you have stumbled in your iniquity" is not about sins in their simple sense, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="2">since all of Israel are presumed to be virtuous,</t>
    <t s="3">and especially after the teshuvah of the month of Elul and the days of Selichos,</t>
    <t s="4">and especially after Rosh HaShanah when all of Israel are vindicated in judgment,</t>
    <t s="5">to the extent that even on the eve of Rosh HaShanah they already know with certainty that they will be vindicated in judgment,</t>
    <t s="6">for "Your people are all righteous,"</t>
    <t s="7">and especially after the shofar blowing, when the matter of wealth occurs</t>
    <t s="8">[as is known, that which our sages, of blessed memory, said,</t>
    <t s="9">"she becomes wealthy at its conclusion" is immediately after the shofar blowing],</t>
    <t s="10">and the teshuvah of Shabbos Shuvah</t>
    <t s="11">(after Rosh HaShanah)</t>
    <t s="12">is only regarding the selfhood of "there is one who loves"</t>
    <t s="13">(and within this itself—in the ultimate subtlety),</t>
    <t s="14">as above</t>
    <t s="15">(section 7),</t>
    <t s="16">so too is it regarding the teshuvah of "do good" and "seek peace,"</t>
    <t s="17">that although these matters were also done previously,</t>
    <t s="18">the teshuvah of Shabbos Shuvah is that the fulfillment of the commandments be with even greater beauty,</t>
    <t s="19">and so too regarding engaging in Torah, and particularly in the inner dimensions of Torah as revealed in the Torah of Chassidus, and especially in the Chassidus of Chabad,</t>
    <t s="20">including also the matter of "may your wellsprings spread forth outward,"</t>
    <t s="21">until "the earth will be filled with knowledge of the L-rd as the waters cover the sea,"</t>
    <t s="22">that it be a year of Torah, a year of teshuvah, and a year of prayer,</t>
    <t s="23">and likewise all the blessings of all the letters,</t>
    <t s="24">a year of light, a year of blessing, a year of redemption, etc.,</t>
    <t s="25">and particularly—the primary blessing,</t>
    <t s="26">the complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach, speedily and truly.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
